title: POST /api/integration/notifications/handover (body)
description: Notifications the integration queued while the hub did not answer (connection error, timeout, HTTP 502/503/504 on POST /api/integration/notify), oldest first, 1-50 per call. Meanwhile the integration wrote them into the device's notification sensor (client-notifications-sensor.json, listed in pending_handover). Per item the hub creates the notification with the given notification_id and created_at, or reports it as a duplicate when it already has that id for the same device; from then on the hub is the source of truth. Integration token only.

client_id.description: One paired device (never "all": a broadcast was expanded by the integration, one item and id per device).

notification_id.description: Lowercase UUID chosen by the integration; the same id as in the sensor (and in the notify call the hub did not answer).

created_at.description: When the notification was sent (with offset); stored normalized to UTC. Older than 72 h: skipped (expired).

status.description: delivered: the app already confirmed it through Home Assistant (ack_notifications) during the outage; stored with delivered_via 'remote' and not pushed again. pending: pushed to the connected app like a new notification.
